title: rosa × insignis
intro: Rosa × insignis, commonly known as the Rosa × alba 'Maxima', is a hybrid rose plant that is a cross between Rosa gallica and Rosa banksiae. This plant is valued for its large, fragrant, and white flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Rosa × insignis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a nervine and a sedative, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may help to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety.
